entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kaneshiro got rid of[n]those photos, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's what he said.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You think we can trust him?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I doubt he'd lie if he really[n]had a change of heart.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like we're all clear then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We can't be sure of that just yet.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean he might not have[n]had a change of heart?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, I'm relatively certain he[n]did. That is not the issue.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Despite Kaneshiro's change,[n]his organization remains intact.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can only hope they don't[n]abscond with the photographs.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'mean like, run off with it?[n]I guess that is possible...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: After all, loss of the leader[n]does not necessarily spell out[n]the demise of the group.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is merely common knowledge.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But the opposite sometimes[n]holds true as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Some groups that lack a strong[n]guiding hand will simply crumble.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So this all depends on[n]which way it goes...
We'll be fine.
I'm worried...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All we can do now is pray[n]the pieces fall in our favor.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hopefully Kaneshiro's confession[n]motivates the police to crack[n]down on the mafia...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I would love nothing more than to[n]see them defeated once and for all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That part'll be up to Makoto's sis.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, we've done everything[n]we can for the time being.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All that remains now is to wait[n]until the result becomes clear.
